data.desc: SolarEdge Technologies is a global leader in smart energy technology that applies engineering and innovation to power management across generation, storage and consumption. The company develops DC-optimized power electronics, energy management and optimization solutions, energy storage and grid services, with technology installed in more than 146 countries. SolarEdge is applying two decades of PV DC power electronics and DC protection experience to AI data center infrastructure and is developing an MVAC-to-800 VDC AI Factory Power Technology platform spanning medium-voltage conversion, distribution, protection and monitoring.
